title: Wilbur and Trees
statementMd:
Wilbur the pig really wants to be a beaver, so he decided today to pretend he is a beaver and bite at trees to cut them down.

There are $*n*$ trees located at various positions on a line. Tree $*i*$ is located at position $*x*_{*i*}$. All the given positions of the trees are distinct.

The trees are equal, i.e. each tree has height $*h*$. Due to the wind, when a tree is cut down, it either falls left with probability $*p*$, or falls right with probability $1 - *p*$. If a tree hits another tree while falling, that tree will fall in the same direction as the tree that hit it. A tree can hit another tree only if the distance between them is strictly less than $*h*$.

For example, imagine there are $4$ trees located at positions $1$, $3$, $5$ and $8$, while $*h* = 3$ and the tree at position $1$ falls right. It hits the tree at position $3$ and it starts to fall too. In it's turn it hits the tree at position $5$ and it also starts to fall. The distance between $8$ and $5$ is exactly $3$, so the tree at position $8$ will not fall.

As long as there are still trees standing, Wilbur will select either the leftmost standing tree with probability $0.5$ or the rightmost standing tree with probability $0.5$. Selected tree is then cut down. If there is only one tree remaining, Wilbur always selects it. As the ground is covered with grass, Wilbur wants to know the expected total length of the ground covered with fallen trees after he cuts them all down because he is concerned about his grass-eating cow friends. Please help Wilbur.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers, $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000)$ and $*h*$ $(1 ≤ *h* ≤ 10^{8})$ and a real number $*p*$ ($0 ≤ *p* ≤ 1$), given with no more than six decimal places.

The second line of the input contains $*n*$ integers, $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $( - 10^{8} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8})$ in no particular order.

## Output

Print a single real number — the expected total length of the ground covered by trees when they have all fallen down. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

## Note

Consider the first example, we have 2 trees with height 2.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b522f18a6495de3bfd40d765a9b707fd31eaad89.png)

There are 3 scenarios:

1. Both trees falls left. This can either happen with the right tree falling left first, which has ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d0f634778b5b369e93c5e4521921161fd08259cb.png) probability (also knocking down the left tree), or the left tree can fall left and then the right tree can fall left, which has ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/641d3274da41b4a98609d2f4fad1fa35c9a8a0a1.png) probability. Total probability is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ef2d54b84025327b541b1c00210b659d1ed21135.png).

2. Both trees fall right. This is analogous to (1), so the probability of this happening is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/43481774386d410a1bf5213c8638987fd86ac23a.png).

3. The left tree fall left and the right tree falls right. This is the only remaining scenario so it must have ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0166ed98b57be8fa0496443c205adee6e32c4f0b.png) probability.

Cases 1 and 2 lead to a total of 3 units of ground covered, while case 3 leads to a total of 4 units of ground covered. Thus, the expected value is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/558a70d9a0e95f0b97db05aac6ef64a78d8e80fb.png).
statementZhMd:
威尔伯这头猪非常想成为一只海狸，所以今天他决定假装自己是海狸，通过啃咬树木将它们砍倒。

有 $*n*$ 棵树位于一条直线上的不同位置。第 $*i*$ 棵树位于位置 $*x*_{*i*}$。所有给定的树的位置均不相同。

这些树的高度相同，每棵树的高度都是 $*h*$。由于风的影响，一棵树被砍倒时，会以概率 $*p*$ 向左倒下，或以概率 $1 - *p*$ 向右倒下。如果一棵树倒下时撞到了另一棵树，那么被撞到的树也会沿着撞击它的树倒下的方向倒下。只有当两棵树之间的距离严格小于 $*h*$ 时，一棵树才可能撞到另一棵树。

例如，假设有 $4$ 棵树分别位于位置 $1$、$3$、$5$ 和 $8$，且 $*h* = 3$。如果位置 $1$ 的树向右倒下，它会撞到位置 $3$ 的树，于是位置 $3$ 的树也开始倒下。接着，它又会撞到位置 $5$ 的树，位置 $5$ 的树也开始倒下。位置 $8$ 和位置 $5$ 之间的距离恰好为 $3$，因此位置 $8$ 的树不会倒下。

只要还有树直立着，威尔伯就会以 $0.5$ 的概率选择当前最左边的直立树，或以 $0.5$ 的概率选择当前最右边的直立树。如果只剩下一棵树，威尔伯总是选择它。由于地面上覆盖着草，威尔伯想知道在砍倒所有树后，被倒下的树覆盖的地面的总长度的期望值，因为他很在意那些以草为食的牛朋友。请帮助威尔伯。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$）和 $*h*$（$1 ≤ *h* ≤ 10^{8}$），以及一个实数 $*p*$（$0 ≤ *p* ≤ 1$）。$*p*$ 最多包含六位小数。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$ - 10^{8} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}$），顺序任意。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数，即所有树倒下后被树覆盖的地面的总长度的期望值。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测机的答案为 $*b*$。检查程序将在满足以下条件时认为你的答案正确：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png)。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例，其中有 $2$ 棵高度为 $2$ 的树。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b522f18a6495de3bfd40d765a9b707fd31eaad89.png)

共有 $3$ 种情况：

1. 两棵树都向左倒下。这可能是先由右边的树向左倒下，此时它会撞倒左边的树，其概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d0f634778b5b369e93c5e4521921161fd08259cb.png)；也可能是左边的树先向左倒下，然后右边的树向左倒下，其概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/641d3274da41b4a98609d2f4fad1fa35c9a8a0a1.png)。总概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ef2d54b84025327b541b1c00210b659d1ed21135.png)。

2. 两棵树都向右倒下。这与情况（1）类似，因此发生这种情况的概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/43481774386d410a1bf5213c8638987fd86ac23a.png)。

3. 左边的树向左倒下，右边的树向右倒下。这是唯一剩下的情况，因此其概率必为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0166ed98b57be8fa0496443c205adee6e32c4f0b.png)。

情况 $1$ 和 $2$ 会使总共有 $3$ 个单位长度的地面被覆盖，而情况 $3$ 会使总共有 $4$ 个单位长度的地面被覆盖。因此，期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/558a70d9a0e95f0b97db05aac6ef64a78d8e80fb.png)。
